'''The Farrier's Green''' is a [[tavern]] in [[Caemlyn]]. It was the location where [[Jowdry]] was murdered by the ''[[gholam]]''. [[Matrim Cauthon]] heard of this when he was dicing in the city.{{ref/book|13|8}}
